condition: With pyarrow 26.0.0, importing pyarrow raises ImportError when NumPy 1.x is installed, because the wheel metadata doesn't say it needs numpy>=2, so pip and uv never upgrade NumPy.
workaround: Install "numpy>=2" alongside pyarrow 26 (or add it to a constraints file), or pin pyarrow<26 if you must stay on NumPy 1.x.
